title: 薰衣草的小空隙
goal: 用笔触密度表现成团植物并留通气空隙
scene: Two low crescent-shaped groups of lavender plants face each other around an OPEN WHITE winding gap at center. Broad simplified muted-teal stems, pale lavender flower spikes with small deeper-purple dabs, very pale gray-green ground and pale beige sunny patch. View slightly from above, no rows extending to horizon, no buildings. About 12 main flower spikes, generous open paper.
decision: 自己决定中央空隙宽度；不要用紫色填满整片
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square standalone original S002 sunlit brushstroke landscape artwork on white marker paper. Transparent oil/alcohol student-marker aesthetic, broad readable color masses and selective natural short plant strokes, sunny light and shadow groups, airy white paper, NO thick black outlines, NO cute faces. No printed words, numbers, panels, color swatches, watermarks or tools. Use only stated approximate hue families, slight same-marker overlap allowed; no smooth digital gradients, opaque impasto or pale strokes painted over dark. Reserve white shapes BEFORE color. No unnecessary microdetail or dense all-over texture. Narrow natural white margins. Composition must be distinct from other scenes. Intended for 16.5cm square marker paper. Stage: D2 specialized control, ONE primary skill, sparse simple scene. Scene: Two low crescent-shaped groups of lavender plants face each other around an OPEN WHITE winding gap at center. review_note: 当前成品笔触与枝叶比专项课目标偏密；正式D2教案需减至少量植物组、减少细节，或分次练习。
